blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: FCFS serves arrival order; SJF selects the shortest available complete job.

blocks.title: Trace
blocks.text: SRT can preempt when a newly ready job has shorter remaining time; RR cycles by quantum.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Multilevel feedback queues adapt priority by task behaviour. Compare responsiveness, waits, starvation and context-switch overhead.

blocks.title: Predict first
blocks.text: Arrival order A,B,C gives mean waiting (0+3+5)/3=8/3.

blocks.title: Model and check
blocks.text: Explain why each value follows from the earlier step.
